# App Registration

This layer handles app registration and GitHub API interactions.

## Overview

The App Registration layer is responsible for managing the registration of the Docturnal app with GitHub and for interacting with the GitHub API to perform various tasks.

## Responsibilities

- **PKCS#1 to PKCS#8 Conversion**: Manages the conversion of PKCS#1 keys to PKCS#8 format for WebCrypto.
- **Request Handling**: Manages incoming requests and schedules tasks.

## How it works

- **app/scripts**: Contains scripts for handling PKCS#1 to PKCS#8 conversions and serving the app registration page.
  - `pkcs8.mjs`: Converts PKCS#1 to PKCS#8 for WebCrypto.
  - `register.mjs`: Serves the app registration page on `http://localhost:8790`.

- **app/src**: Manages GitHub API version, handles requests, schedules tasks, manages session tokens, and configures workflows for GitHub installations.
  - `github.ts`: Defines the version of the GitHub REST API used by the app.
  - `handlers.ts`: Contains handlers for webhooks and queue tasks.
  - `index.ts`: Defines the backend for the Docturnal GitHub App, handling webhooks, serving the settings page, managing repository setups, and running nightly runs.
  - `scheduler.ts`: Manages the hourly cron job.
  - `session.ts`: Manages signed, short-lived tokens for the setup page.
  - `settings.ts`: Manages per-installation settings in Cloudflare KV.
  - `setup.ts`: Manages the optional settings page at `/setup`.

## Configuration

- Environment variables: `ACTION_REPOSITORY`, `APP_ID`, `CLIENT_ID`, `CLIENT_SECRET`, `CONTENTS_PATH_STYLE`, `GITHUB_API_URL`, `GITHUB_WEB_URL`, `PRIVATE_KEY`, `PUBLIC_URL`, `SETTINGS`, `SETUP_QUEUE`, `WEBHOOK_SECRET`.
- Configuration files: `.github/workflows/docturnal.yml`, `app/manifest.json`, `app/tsconfig.json`, `app/wrangler.toml`.
